listing.name: MediEvil II / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Explore MediEvil II / Alexbeav PSXRecomp and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start with the precompiled player
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows ZIP into a writable folder. MediEvilIIRecomp.exe is the player and launcher. OpenBIOS is included; no compiler, Python or Generate step is required.

steps.title: Choose your own USA disc
steps.instruction: In the launcher, select your MediEvil II USA SCUS-94564 CUE with its BIN tracks, or a supported CHD, then choose controls and Play. The disc remains required. The first run prepares a verified loading cache; later runs reuse it.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: Windows settings, memory cards, mods and diagnostics live beside the player. Linux uses the documented user-data location and a separate user cache. Preserve this data when updating an external copy; Portcove does not back up or replace that copy. Adding a native player saves launch details; Play is separate.
